description.text:
The deck that won the Masters Division of the 2008 World Championships and made its player the first to win two world titles. It is a Gardevoir and Gallade deck, the most popular kind that year, changed to beat any opponent, other Gardevoir and Gallade decks included. The 2008 World Championships were held at the Hilton Orlando Lake Buena Vista in Orlando, Florida, from 15 to 17 August 2008.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2008 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
